documents.title: Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('LODR Regulations')
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported a 6.9% expansion in ice cream volumes for Q2 FY19, supported by strong domestic growth and a 37% increase in international business. The company achieved significant margin expansion due to lower raw material costs, operating efficiencies, and higher realizations from export sales. Management is focused on debt rationalization, reducing overall debt to Rs. 94 crore, and plans to expand its distribution network by adding 10,000 new sales outlets in FY19.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by consumption trends and international traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

guidance.claim: Subdued raw material prices are expected to benefit future margins.
guidance.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9% in Q2, with international business growing by 37%.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: International business is seeing robust demand from the Indian diaspora in the US and other markets.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: The company estimated its capital expenditure for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for further capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin improved by approximately 1,000 bps.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion was achieved through volume growth, lower raw material prices, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

margins_costs.claim: Higher realizations from international ice cream sales are contributing to improved profits.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

orders_capacity.claim: Daily production capacity has been expanded to 380,000 liters.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

capital_allocation.claim: The company is reconstituting debt to increase long-tenure loans and reduce costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Cash accretion and working capital improvements are being used for debt rationalization.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic growth was temporarily affected by changes in the operating environment and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: The company estimated FY19 capital expenditure at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore
